tldr: 台股週五收跌 170.79 點至 44,225.91 點，但週線仍漲 2.57% 站回月線與季線，迎接數據密集的一週。
鴻海 7 月營收創高 9,465 億元（年增 54%），廣達、緯創、仁寶 7 月營收同創新高，AI 伺服器需求帶動 DRAM 第三季再漲最多 20%。
金融三業上半年大賺 9,042 億元（年增 139%），高股息 ETF 00878 配息創高每單位 1.01 元，8 月除息旺季登場。

items.title_zh: 台股週五收黑 但週線大漲 2.57%
items.title_en: TAIEX ends Friday lower but books a 2.57% weekly gain
items.summary_zh: 台股 8/7 開高走低，獲利了結賣壓使指數翻黑，終場跌 170.79 點、收 44,225.91 點、跌幅 0.38%，成交量縮至約 8,192 億元。儘管單日收黑，加權指數本週仍漲 1,106 點、週漲 2.57%，收出站回月線與季線的週紅 K，中期趨勢轉強。台積電逆勢收漲 5 元至 2,370 元，撐住權值。量縮續守月、季線，短線於高檔震盪整理，市場等待下週營收與數據指引方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark opened higher on Aug 7 before profit-taking dragged it into the red, closing down 170.79 points, or 0.38%, at 44,225.91 as turnover shrank to about NT$819bn. Despite the daily dip, the index rose 1,106 points, or 2.57%, on the week — a bullish weekly candle that reclaimed both the monthly and quarterly moving averages. TSMC bucked the trend, closing up NT$5 at NT$2,370.

items.title_zh: 外資賣超 407 億但期貨回補空單 下週聚焦營收與 CPI
items.title_en: Foreign selling of NT$40.7bn masks futures short-covering; revenue week looms
items.summary_zh: 外資 8/7 於現貨市場大賣 407 億元，卻同步在期貨市場回補空單，此背離顯示籌碼面未如現貨賣壓般偏空。市場焦點轉向關鍵一週：台積電、聯發科將公布 7 月營收，美國將公布 7 月 CPI，投資人緊盯 44,000 點能否守住這道短線多方防線。營收數字被視為「AI 投資變現」的最直接證據，牽動台股後市攻守，波動料加大。
items.summary_en: Foreign investors dumped a net NT$40.7bn in the cash market on Aug 7, yet simultaneously covered short positions in index futures, a divergence that hints at less bearish positioning than the spot selling suggests. Attention now turns to a pivotal week: TSMC and MediaTek report July revenue, the US releases July CPI, and traders watch whether the 44,000 level holds as the market's first line of defence.

items.title_zh: 鴻海 7 月營收 9,465 億創高 首度站上 9 千億
items.title_en: Hon Hai's July revenue tops NT$946.5bn record, first month above NT$900bn
items.summary_zh: 鴻海 7 月自結合併營收達 9,465.13 億元，年增 54.19%、月增 15.18%，為單月營收首度突破 9,000 億元大關，主要受惠 AI 伺服器拉貨強勁與雲端網路產品成長。累計前 7 月營收 5.59 兆元、年增 37.89%，創歷年同期新高。公司看好第三季 AI 機櫃維持成長、ICT 產品進入下半年旺季，營運可望季增與年增雙成長，續為台股 AI 供應鏈核心動能。
items.summary_en: Hon Hai (Foxconn) reported record July revenue of NT$946.51bn, up 54.19% year on year and 15.18% from June, its first month ever above NT$900bn, powered by strong AI-server pull-in and a cloud-networking surge. Cumulative January-July revenue reached NT$5.59tn, up 37.89% and a record for the period. The company guides for both sequential and annual growth in the third quarter as AI racks and peak-season ICT demand build.

items.title_zh: 廣達緯創仁寶 7 月營收同創高 DRAM 第三季估再漲 20%
items.title_en: Quanta, Wistron, Compal post record July sales as DRAM set to rise up to 20% in Q3
items.summary_zh: 台灣 AI 伺服器代工三雄 7 月營收齊創同期新高：廣達約 3,662.74 億元、年增 1.3 倍，前 7 月 2.21 兆元、年增 92.7%，緯創、仁寶亦寫下同期高點。零組件供給持續吃緊，主流 PC 用 DDR4 8Gb DRAM 7 月報價創高，分析師示警 AI 伺服器需求排擠供給，PC 端 DRAM 第三季恐再漲最多 20%，牽動下游成本與備料策略，供應鏈能見度拉長。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's AI-server assemblers all logged record July revenue: Quanta booked about NT$366.3bn, up 130% year on year, with seven-month sales of NT$2.21tn (up 92.7%), while Wistron and Compal also hit period highs. Component tightness is intensifying — mainstream PC DDR4 8Gb DRAM prices reached record levels in July, and analysts warn PC DRAM could climb a further 20% in the third quarter as AI-server demand crowds out supply.

items.title_zh: 金融三業上半年賺逾 9 千億 年增 139% 創同期新高
items.title_en: Taiwan's three financial sectors earn NT$904.2bn in H1, up 139%
items.summary_zh: 據金管會統計，台灣銀行、保險、證券期貨三大金融產業 2026 上半年合計獲利 9,042.45 億元，年增 139.14%，創歷年同期新高，全年獲利有望挑戰歷史新高。壽險業獲利回升為主要動能。亮眼獲利雖強化金融業資本體質與配息能力，但也墊高下半年比較基期，投資人須留意獲利成長動能能否延續，以及利率、匯率與資本市場波動對後續表現的影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's banking, insurance and securities-and-futures sectors together earned NT$904.245bn in the first half of 2026, a 139.14% jump year on year and a record for the period, according to regulator data. Life insurers' recovery drove much of the swing, and the full year is on course to challenge an all-time high. The bumper profits strengthen sector capital buffers but also raise the bar for second-half comparisons.

items.title_zh: 金管會出手穩母金控資本 撐配息
items.title_en: FSC moves to stabilise financial-holding capital and safeguard dividends
items.summary_zh: 金管會為因應壽險業接軌新一代清償能力制度（ICS）與 IFRS 17，出手穩定具壽險子公司的母金控資本適足性，讓 8 家保險型金控鬆一口氣。透過放寬相關集團合併資本適足申報空間，主管機關力求維持金控配息能力，對重視現金股利的股東是一大利多，也讓業者在會計與清償能力新制轉換期間有更充裕的調整時間，降低對市場信心的衝擊。
items.summary_en: The FSC has acted to shore up the capital positions of parent financial-holding companies with life-insurance subsidiaries, easing pressure on eight insurance-oriented financial holdings as insurers transition to the new-generation ICS solvency regime and IFRS 17. By allowing affected groups more room on consolidated capital-adequacy reporting, the regulator aims to keep dividend capacity intact — a relief for income-focused shareholders while the industry beds in the sweeping accounting and solvency overhaul.

items.title_zh: 00878 配息 1.01 元創高 8 月 ETF 除息旺季登場
items.title_en: 00878 declares record NT$1.01 payout as August's ETF dividend season peaks
items.summary_zh: 國泰永續高股息（00878）宣布每單位配發 1.01 元、創掛牌新高，預計 8 月 18 日除息，領銜本月逾 19 檔高股息 ETF 的密集除息潮。多檔預估年化殖利率偏高，00878 約 12.4%、00881 達 18.07%、00923 為 15.17%、00961 為 17.5%。理財專家提醒，配息來源涵蓋股利、利息、資本利得與收益平準金，課稅認定不同，投資人應留意稅負與填息能力，而非只看表面殖利率。
items.summary_en: Cathay Sustainability High Dividend (00878) declared a record NT$1.01 per unit, going ex-dividend around Aug 18, headlining a packed August calendar of more than 19 income ETFs. Estimated annualised yields run high — 00878 at about 12.4%, 00881 at 18.07%, 00923 at 15.17% and 00961 at 17.5% — but advisers stress that payout sources vary (dividends, interest, capital gains and levelling reserves) and carry different tax treatment.

items.title_zh: 高配息不等於高報酬 專家籲重視總報酬
items.title_en: High yield is not high return: advisers steer savers to total return
items.summary_zh: 高股息 ETF 為台灣存股族核心配置，財富管理專家重申，表面殖利率無法代表實際獲利。0050、00919、00878 等人氣標的應以含息總報酬、填息能力、成分股體質、費用與配息來源綜合評估，而非只看殖利率高低。在 8 月除息潮達到高峰之際，建議投資人依理財目標與投資期間挑選商品，並留意不同配息來源的課稅差異，落實理性的收益型資產配置，避免賺了配息卻賠了價差。
items.summary_en: With income ETFs central to Taiwanese savers' portfolios, wealth advisers reiterate that a headline yield says little about outcomes. Popular holdings such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 should be judged on total return, dividend-gap recovery, holdings quality, fees and payout sources rather than yield alone. As the August ex-dividend wave peaks, the guidance is to match products to goals and time horizon, and to weigh tax treatment across different distribution sources.
